en.headline: LeonLollipop’s first solo show Gloomie Museum runs at Harbour City until 25 October
en.dek: The exhibition features the artist’s 100th Gloomie portrait, a feline Mona Lisa, plus sculptures of cat soldiers inspired by the Terracotta Army.
body: Local artist Leon Lai, known as LeonLollipop, is holding his first solo exhibition, Gloomie Museum, at Gallery by the Harbour in Harbour City until 25 October.

The show reimagines classical masterpieces and Hong Kong landmarks through the artist’s signature Gloomie cat. It includes the debut of the 100th Gloomie portrait, Gloomie Lisa, a Kai Tak-inspired take on the Mona Lisa, along with seven sculptures paying tribute to Western masters and ten cat soldiers in Terracotta Army style.
The organisers said visitors can collect stamps at four stations to complete a postcard illustration. The gallery is open from 11am to 9pm.
The exhibition is free to enter and is located at Shop 207, Level 2, Ocean Centre, Harbour City in Tsim Sha Tsui.

zh.headline: LeonLollipop首個個人展「Gloomie Museum托腮貓藝術館」於海港城展至10月25日
zh.dek: 展覽包括藝術家第100幅Gloomie肖像「Gloomie Lisa」蒙娜麗莎貓，以及兵馬俑造型貓士兵雕塑。
body: 本地藝術家Leon Lai（LeonLollipop）於尖沙咀海港城美術館舉行首個個人展覽「Gloomie Museum托腮貓藝術館」，展期至10月25日。
展覽以托腮貓Gloomie視角重新詮釋經典名畫及香港地標。焦點包括系列第100幅肖像「Gloomie Lisa」首度亮相，以啟德景觀演繹蒙娜麗莎，另有七款向西方大師致敬的雕塑及十款兵馬俑造型貓士兵。
主辦方表示，觀眾可於四個蓋章站收集印章，完成明信片插畫。美術館開放時間為上午11時至晚上9時。
展覽免費入場，地點為海港城海洋中心二階207號舖。
